apps.name: Scope
apps.subtitle: Camera on one device, monitor on another.
apps.localizedDescription:
Turns one iPhone or iPad into a camera and another into its monitor. Live picture and sound over your own Wi-Fi, encrypted, paired with a family code. No account and nothing uploaded.

Not a medical or safety device. It does not replace an adult checking on a child.

privacy.NSCameraUsageDescription: Scope sends this device's camera picture to your other devices that use the same family code.
privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Scope finds your other devices on this Wi-Fi so the camera and the monitor can connect directly.
privacy.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Scope sends the sound in the room to your other devices that use the same family code.

apps.name: Ripple Chess
apps.subtitle: Chess that shows what each move causes.
apps.localizedDescription: A chess trainer. After every move it shows the consequences as a picture and a plain analogy, with lessons, five opponent levels and five themes.

apps.name: Setmate
apps.subtitle: Set timer, routines and training log.
apps.localizedDescription:
A gym companion. Times sets and rests, builds routines from a 622-exercise library, keeps your history and suggests the next weight. A Mind section covers eating patterns with check-ins, short lessons and an urge timer.

General information only. Not medical advice and not a treatment for an eating disorder.

apps.name: Tidy Dash
apps.subtitle: A tidy-up race for the whole family.
apps.localizedDescription:
Turns cleaning a room into a race. Prop the phone in the middle, put one thing away, run back and hit your pad. Surprise rounds, a Mess Monster to beat together, and a mystery prize for the winner that parents choose.

Stars and a race track let small children follow their score. No account and nothing uploaded.

apps.name: Magic Playground
apps.subtitle: Fourteen floor-play games for small children.
apps.localizedDescription:
Movement and party games for toddlers and the grown-ups with them: statues, Simon says, treasure hunts and story adventures, with narration and music. Floor-level play only. A grown-up awards the stars.

Music and sound credits are in the app under Settings.
